name: Bulky
description: This item takes up two inventory slots instead of one.

name: Burst X
description: Attacks with this weapon affect characters within a radius of X, centered on and including the space occupied by the target. On a successful attack, characters within the radius but not the initial target are dealt half the attack's initial damage and do not suffer any of the attack's damage effects.

name: Close Quarters
description: This weapon is compact and easy to wield in tight confines and the press of melee. Attacks with this weapon suffer no penalty when used to make a ranged attack while within the target's Reach.

name: Effortless
description: When this item is used in conjunction with a 1H weapon, you may reroll 1d20 when attacking with that weapon as if the hand holding this item was free.

name: Extended X
description: This weapon has Reach X. You may attack an adjacent target with this weapon even if they are 1 Height above or below you.

name: Heavy
description: Attacks with this weapon have +1 Difficulty unless the weapon is braced or you have a Brawn of 10 or higher. A 1H weapon is braced when wielded in two hands. A 2H weapon is braced if a Minor Action is spent to ready a stance before striking with it.

name: Knockback X
description: Successful attacks with this weapon push the target X spaces away in a direction of the attacker's choice.

name: Loading
description: This weapon requires ammunition in order to be fired. You must spend a Minor Action to load this weapon before you may attack with it.

name: Parrying
description: When this item's wielder makes an opposed test to defend against a melee attack, they may re-roll a single d20 on their test. This does not stack if the character has multiple Parrying items and cannot apply while wielding a weapon with the Spear tag.

name: Reliable X
description: When you miss on an attack with this weapon, it still deals X damage. This damage applies after the counterstrike damage is dealt, if any.

name: Saddleback
description: This weapon is especially effective when used while mounted. When a character attacks with this weapon while mounted, they do not suffer the normal increase in Difficulty from mounted attacks.

name: Subtle
description: Attacks with this weapon are difficult to detect. Attacks made while Hidden using a subtle weapon gain [CD] damage equal to the wielder's Intrigue.

name: Thrown X
description: You can make up to X ranged attacks with this weapon before it is depleted. You may additionally use this weapon to make a melee attack that deals -2[CD], so long as it is not depleted.

name: Concealing
description: Ranged attacks made against you gain +1 Difficulty. You provide Half-Cover to all adjacent allies.

name: Exhausting
description: This item is tiring to use. While this item is equipped, the wearer's speed and the speed of any mount they ride on is reduced by 2. This effect stacks if you have multiple Exhausting items equipped. Additionally, if you have this item equipped longer than a number of hours equal to your Brawn - 8 in a day, you suffer a Complication on every Task until you have sufficiently rested.

name: Overt X
description: This armor increases the Difficulty of any Task to Hide or be stealthy by X.

name: Defensive
description: While equipped, this item grants you a bonus die when defending against attacks.
